E2-2023-T3-P1-S2.trunk: S+V+O：Sparrow led a study（斯帕罗主持了一项研究）
structure: └ 定语从句(in which)：in which participants were asked
└ 不定式宾补：to record 40 factoids in a computer
└ 括号举例："an ostrich's eye is bigger than its brain," for example
E2-2023-T3-P1-S2.logic: 主句只交代研究；in which 从句展开研究任务，被动结构 were asked 后接不定式；括号内容给出 factoid 的具体例子。
notes: factoid 在此指一条简短、零碎的事实。
in which 可替换为 where，但正式程度更高。
be asked to do 表示被要求做某事。

E2-2023-T3-P1-S13.trunk: S+V+O：The trend will change our approach to learning（这一趋势会改变我们的学习方式）
structure: 主句：Perhaps the trend will change our approach to learning
变化范围：from a focus on individual facts and memorization
└ 对应终点(to)：to an emphasis on more conceptual thinking
└ 定语从句(that)：that is not available on the Internet
E2-2023-T3-P1-S13.logic: from...to...明确学习重心的迁移；破折号后的 something 回指 conceptual thinking，并指出这种能力不能直接从互联网取得。
notes: approach to 中 to 是介词，后接 learning。
a focus on...to an emphasis on... 是平行结构。
available on the Internet 在此不是“联网可用”，而是“网上现成可得”。

E2-2023-T3-P1-S17.trunk: 倒装比较：Surfing the web exercised the brain more than reading did（上网比阅读更能调动大脑）
structure: 主句：surfing the web exercised the brain more than reading did
适用人群：among computer-savvy older adults
└ 地点机构：at the Semel Institute... at the University of California, Los Angeles
E2-2023-T3-P1-S17.logic: 句首 And 承接前文证据；核心是 more than 比较，上网与阅读是两个并列比较项；后面连续介词短语只补充人群、研究和机构。
notes: reading did 中 did 代替 exercised the brain，避免重复。
computer-savvy 表示熟悉、善于使用电脑。
